lessons.title: Lunch for Three Different Plans
lessons.goal: 整合對話中的個人條件與共用訂單。
lessons.story:
[Lunch chat]
Ella: We have an art practice at noon. Should I order three lunches from Green Corner?
Max: Yes, but I don’t eat meat. Please choose the vegetable sandwich for me.
June: I can eat either sandwich. I have a meeting at twelve thirty, so I need mine early.
Ella: The shop delivers only at twelve twenty. We usually spend twenty minutes eating. Would you like to collect yours on the way here?
June: I can pass the shop at eleven forty-five. Could I pick up all three instead?
Max: That would help. What about drinks?
Ella: We all have water bottles, so let’s order sandwiches only.
June: Please send me the order number after the shop confirms it. I’ll check the names on the bags before leaving.
Ella: Done. Two cheese sandwiches and one vegetable sandwich, with no drinks.

words.example: The shop can deliver at twelve twenty.
Wait until the shop confirms the order.
Check the order number on the bags.

questions.prompt: Which lunch does Max ask for?
options: A bowl of soup.
A cheese sandwich.
A meat pie.
A vegetable sandwich.
questions.explanation: Max 不吃肉並指定蔬菜三明治。
questions.evidence: Please choose the vegetable sandwich for me.

questions.prompt: Why do they order no drinks?
options: The shop sells only hot drinks.
They already have water bottles.
June cannot carry any bags.
Drinks would arrive at a different school.
questions.explanation: 三人都有水瓶，因此只訂餐點。
questions.evidence: We all have water bottles, so let’s order sandwiches only.

questions.prompt: What problem does June’s pickup plan solve?
options: It makes her meeting start later.
It removes the need to check the order.
It gives her lunch before the shop’s delivery time.
It changes Max’s food preference.
questions.explanation: 外送12:20，June12:30開會來不及以平常速度吃完；提前領餐可留足時間。
questions.evidence: The shop delivers only at twelve twenty.
reasons: 和11:45取餐對照可更早拿到。

questions.prompt: What does “either” mean in June’s first message?
options: Both sandwiches must be eaten together.
Only the vegetable sandwich.
One or the other of the two sandwiches.
None of the sandwiches.
questions.explanation: either在此表示兩款任一都可以。
reasons: 表示兩種選擇都能接受。

questions.prompt: If June starts eating at 12:20 and takes the usual twenty minutes, when does she finish?
options: At 12:30, exactly when her meeting starts.
At 12:25, before her meeting starts.
At 11:45, when she passes the shop.
At 12:40, after her meeting starts.
questions.evidence: We usually spend twenty minutes eating.
reasons: 同時整合用餐時間與會議時間。

options: One cheese sandwich with two drinks.
Two vegetable sandwiches and one cheese sandwich, without drinks.
Three vegetable sandwiches with three drinks.
Two cheese sandwiches and one vegetable sandwich, without drinks.
questions.explanation: 最後確認訊息給出品項、份數及不含飲料。
questions.evidence: Two cheese sandwiches and one vegetable sandwich, with no drinks.
reasons: 少了兩份餐，且加了飲料。
三明治品項與飲料都錯。
